title: Rows, columns, values
text: Arrange fields into rows, columns, and values with sum, average, count, and more.

title: Totals and subtotals
text: Grand totals for rows, columns, or both, and optional column subtotals.

title: Field list
text: A companion field list lets users rearrange the layout and filter members.

title: Local or server data
text: Aggregate rows in the browser or plug in a data source that aggregates on a server.

title: Export the result
text: Read the result as a matrix or download it as CSV.
